welcome.metaTitle: Fursa · Find the jobs that fit you
welcome.metaDescription: Fursa collects jobs from several sources, scores each one against your profile and tells you about the good ones. It never applies for you.
welcome.headline: Find the jobs that fit you.
welcome.intro: Fursa collects jobs from several sources, scores each one against your profile, and tells you about the good ones.

one.title: Tell Fursa what you look for
one.text: Add the roles, skills, places and level you want.

two.title: Fursa scores each job
two.text: It collects jobs from several sources and scores each one against you.

three.title: You get a short list, with reasons
three.text: Each job says why it fits you. If you want, you also get alerts on Telegram or by email.

example.label: Example feed

detail.why: Your profile lists Python, SQL and Docker, which this job asks for. The role is in Tunis, one of the places you chose. It also asks for Kubernetes, which your profile does not mention.

doesNot.title: What Fursa does not do
doesNot.text: Fursa never applies for you. You read why a job matches, open the posting, and apply yourself.
